description: Prompt for classifying a block as a harness, project or environment issue, with its reasoning, for the grouped engines' Blocked (ASS-107; ASS-163: a project issue is checked against the latest master before any bug is raised): where its fix is made; ASS-390: or a dependency — the block only waits for one of the ticket's own dependency merge requests to merge, sent back to Build's Await Sequential Merge — each outcome an exit of grouped-blocked's Classify; it logs what it found in the change log, and cites only what it read; ASS-391: or a rate limit, ASS-395: or a credential; ASS-492: or own work that is incomplete, nothing failing — a missing change and its repository, planned as a merge request and sent back to Generate Solution

input-arguments.name: problem
input-arguments.description: The checked analysis of the problem: summary, root cause, evidence
input-arguments.example: Dev container needs rebuilding: node 24 image changed

issue.description: Where the fix is made: harness (a fix ticket in the harness project's backlog), project (the cause is in the project's own code: checked against the latest master next, a bug raised in the project's own ticket system only when it fails there; the harness's backlog on the harness project), environment (where the work runs: repaired in place, else by the operator); dependency (ASS-390: no fault — it only waits for one of the ticket's own merge requests, one another depends on in another repository, to merge: back to Build's Await Sequential Merge); rate-limit (ASS-391: no fault of the ticket's — Claude usage or rate limits stopped its agents: Await Rate Limit resumes it on the API key fallback at once, or once the limit resets); credentials (ASS-395 AC5: a missing or failing credential — keychain item, token, login: a fresh credentials check; the project held, the ticket waits for the operator's fix there; else Blocked for Human with this reasoning); image (ASS-392: the project's golden image, the ticket's VM cloned from it, or the local image registry: Repair Image on the Mac, one golden rebuild at a time — ASS-427: only what cannot be fixed in the ticket's VM, the Lima template, kernel settings, the image's build); vm (ASS-427: a problem in the ticket's VM fixable in place there with a source every VM shares — a tool or package the image lacks, a cache or pulled image, a harness-written VM file missing an entry because its non-secret declaration lacks it, the credential valid: Repair the VM fixes it there at once and in its source for later VMs, never waiting for a rebuild)

own-branch.description: Project only (ASS-384): true when the cause is in what the ticket's own branch adds or changes (Troubleshoot's failing-file), not in master's code; its merged merge requests count too (ASS-423); the harness checks master and the branch, then sends the ticket back to Generate Solution; left out otherwise; ASS-492: also true when nothing failed but the ticket's own work lacks a change (missing-change)

human-action.description: Environment or credentials (ASS-395) only: what the operator must do should it not be repaired in place; left out otherwise

dependency-merge-request.description: Dependency only (ASS-390): the merge request the block waits for — its planned id, key or url, from ticket:merge-request-plan; left out otherwise

missing-change.description: Project, own-branch true only (ASS-492): nothing failed, but the ticket's own work is incomplete — the change it still needs, what the new or existing merge request must hold, in one line (e.g. bump @scope/* to 1.0.0-preview.85 in package.json and the lockfile); the harness plans it on the ticket's merge request in missing-change-repository still Open or Not Created, else a new one, and sends the ticket back to Generate Solution; left out otherwise

missing-change-repository.description: With missing-change only (ASS-492): the forge url of the project's repository (project.json's repositories) the change goes in; left out otherwise
